fields.source: Dry brush gives the branch its rough, broken edge.
fields.target: “枯筆”讓枝幹出現粗糙、斷續的邊緣。

fields.source: Placing the blossoms along the branch keeps them off the empty paper.
fields.target: 把梅花放在枝條上，空白處就不會被花朵佔滿。

fields.source: Naming the corner keeps the seal away from the branch.
fields.target: 寫明角落，印章就不會壓在枝條上。

fields.source: The count sets the rhythm across the scroll; five stays open.
fields.target: 數量決定長卷的節奏，五根恰好留有空隙。

fields.source: “Drifting” turns stiff leaf clusters into loose, overlapping sprays.
fields.target: “飄落”讓僵硬的葉簇變成鬆散交疊的枝葉。

fields.source: The only colour in the image; it marks where the eye ends.
fields.target: 畫面裡唯一的顏色，標出視線的終點。

fields.source: The circle lifts a green tin off a green wall.
fields.target: 圓形背景把綠色茶罐從綠色牆面上托出來。

fields.source: This selling point became the paper label band; quality claims tend to turn into labels.
fields.target: 這個賣點變成了紙質標籤帶；品質類賣點往往會被畫成標籤。

fields.source: The largest shape anchors the upper right and sets the warm accent.
fields.target: 最大的圖形壓住右上角，定下暖色重點。

fields.source: “Thin” keeps the arc a line, so it adds motion without a second heavy shape.
fields.target: “細”讓弧線保持為線條，增加動感而不多出一塊重色。

fields.source: A half circle on the left balances the disc on the right.
fields.target: 左側的半圓與右側的圓盤形成平衡。

fields.source: A quiet texture that fills the lower right without competing.
fields.target: 安靜的紋理填補右下角，又不搶戲。

fields.source: Bars reserve space for the event name; asking for real text often comes out garbled.
fields.target: 色條為活動名稱預留位置；直接要求文字常常會生成亂碼。

fields.source: Two named colours split the outline left and right; one colour reads as a glow, not a likeness.
fields.target: 兩種顏色把輪廓分成左右兩半；只寫一種顏色會變成光暈，看不出人像。

fields.source: Blurred lights give depth behind a flat silhouette.
fields.target: 虛化的光點讓平面的剪影背後有了縱深。

fields.source: A count keeps toppings from multiplying across the bowl.
fields.target: 寫明數量，配料就不會鋪滿整碗。

fields.source: Naming the yolk colour makes the egg the brightest point in the bowl.
fields.target: 寫出蛋黃的顏色，蛋就成了碗裡最亮的地方。

fields.source: A placed prop leads the eye into the bowl instead of crossing it.
fields.target: 放好位置的道具把視線引入碗中，而不是橫穿畫面。

fields.source: Placing the moon high keeps it clear of the ridges.
fields.target: 把月亮放高，它就不會被山脊遮住。

fields.source: Ordering values from dark to light builds depth without perspective.
fields.target: 由深到淺排列明度，不用透視也能產生縱深。

fields.source: A single glass sphere frames the miniature world and gives it a clear boundary.
fields.target: 用一隻透明球體框住微縮世界，讓邊界清楚可見。

fields.source: The waterfall crosses the tabletop and joins the two scales.
fields.target: 瀑布越過桌邊，把微縮景觀與房間連接起來。
